column1: # Name map of area r2: the game image from 0x8009DC50 up to 0x800B4720 (docs/port/PCONLY.md section 3).
# Reconciled with the other areas' maps (wave 1): docs/code/NAMING.md has the conventions, which override this
# header where they differ, and every decision; each old name has one row over all the maps; labels to delete
# rather than rename are in drop.tsv.
# Columns: old, new, kind, source, confidence, note. The readable map of the area is docs/code/r2.md.
# MAT3 = the GameCube decomp (cabi24/SFRush2049-mat3-decomp); "file header" = the comment above the
# function in src/blob, written by the matching agents. "stub" = an 8-byte jr-ra deleted-procedure body of
# a static that umerge inlined; retail keeps it in place, so it marks where the static sat.
# Names already right are kept (no row): RollUV, PS_FlushPak, PS_FlushFile, PS_WriteFile, PS_ReadFile,
# PS_CreateFile, InitBlits, ZOID_ResetWindows, InitWaves, UnlockWaveInstance, MBOX_FindPalette_WORK,
# Known name overlaps that are the same thing, to clear in wave 2: the zlib_deflate group #defines each zlib
# name to the old label (identity after the rename: drop the #define); ovl_a/ovl_b files #define RemoveBlit,
# NewMultiBlit, InitPane, TB_GetFontLineHeight, HAL_GetTextWidth, HAL_SetFont, TB_Sprintf and ZOID_WindowTo3D
# to the old labels (the same); static inline copies of ZOID_Reset (InitWaves.c, display_list_flush.c),
# ZOID_SetPolyZ (music_control.c), ZOID_GetColor (func_8010C974.c) and RemoveEnvirons (demo_pair/demo.c) are the
# same functions; include/game/*.h (arcade headers that no source includes) declare StartSparks, StartBlast,
# StartFrame, UpdateVisuals, InitSkids, AnimateSkids, UpdateEnvirons, StartCar, CreateCar, StartEnvironment,
# RemoveCar, SetupCar, InitVisuals, NewWorldObject, MBOX_GetObjectRadius, fpitch, froll, AnimateBrakeLights,
# ObjInstanceList, WorldBase, Worlddlidx, gObjList, gTargetList, gEmitters, gCarModelNums with arcade types:
# fix or drop those headers. active_player_count and gNumModels are already the symbols.json names of their data.
